entry.title: πToniC 1.0.2
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.2 A Microtonic-inspired drum machine. πToniC features 8 independent drum voices, each combining filtered noise with a morphing oscillator or WAV sample playback. Its sound engine includes pitch modulation, amplitude envelopes, drive, EQ and individual voice controls. Shared stereo reverb and tempo-synced delay complete the engine. - Fix TONE control bindings so visible controls and contextual Q-Links use the same TUNE/START aliases in SAMPLE and FREQUENCY/WAVE MORPH aliases in SYNTH

entry.title: πToniC 1.0.0
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.0 Eight-voice percussion synthesis with native MPC sequencing, touch controls and shared stereo effects. - Oscillator morphing, filtered noise, amplitude and pitch envelopes, sine/random pitch modulation. - Per-voice drive, EQ, velocity response, pan and choke groups. - A/B comparison, ALTER and RAND VOICE. - Shared reverb and synchronised/free delay, with two sends per voice. - Five touch pages, contextual Q-Links and azure trigger activity. - 150 converted Patternarium BEST kits i
